outcome: Outcome of pregnancy of unknown location (PUL)
Trends of beta-HCG levels in early pregnancy
cohort: 70 pregnant women with suspected early pregnancy and serum beta-HCG levels above 1000 mIU/ml, who met the criteria for pregnancy of unknown location (PUL) based on transvaginal ultrasound.
finding: The majority of women with PUL (pregnancy of unknown location) in this study had an ectopic pregnancy (47%), while 27% experienced a failing pregnancy and 25% had an intrauterine pregnancy (IUP).
